test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence.

(P) the south pole of the Moon

(Q) and where no man has ever been before

(R) the Artemis mission will explore

(S) where ice has been confirmed to exist within craters
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **RPSQ**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "the Artemis mission will explore" which is correctly indicated by **part (R).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "the south pole of the Moon" **(RP)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the Artemis mission will explore.
 
• **The next part,** "where ice has been confirmed to exist within craters," starts the explanation about the south pole, indicated by **(S).**
 
• **Ending with **"and where no man has ever been before" **(Q)** completes the sentence by stating the uniqueness of the mission.

Therefore, the correct answer is **RPSQ.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (PQSR):** This option starts with "the south pole of the Moon and where no man has ever been before where ice has been confirmed to exist within craters the Artemis mission will explore." This sequence is incomplete and does not make sense grammatically.
 
• **Option 3 (SQR):** This option starts with "where ice has been confirmed to exist within craters and where no man has ever been before the Artemis mission will explore the south pole of the Moon," which makes the sentence incorrect as the explanation starts too early, missing contextual flow.
 
• **Option 4 (PRQS):** This option starts with "the south pole of the Moon the Artemis mission will explore and where no man has ever been before where ice has been confirmed to exist within craters," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.
